desc:
💨 HOLD IT IN... OR IT WILL FIND YOU 💨

A monster hunts the halls, and it can't see you. But it can HEAR you. Every step fills your fart meter. Sprint, jump or get too close to the monster and it fills even faster. If you let one rip, it knows exactly where you are.

🚽 Find toilets to safely empty your meter
🔒 Hide in lockers when it gets close (just DON'T fart inside!)
🏃 Slide and crawl through gaps to escape
💣 Throw Stink Bombs to lure it away
🔧 Pull the levers to open the final gate and ESCAPE

🔥 FEATURES
• Play solo or with friends
• Easy, Normal and Hard difficulties
• Upgrades: Speed, Iron Gut, Better Vision and more
• Daily rewards with a FREE NUKE on Day 7
• Leaderboards for the fastest escapes
• Become the Monster and hunt your friends!

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for new updates!
